joints.scope: Coefficient kernel, selected SymPy callgraph/backend, mixed-int/power/division routes, all calibrators and19adapter admission cases.
joints.attack_plan: First independently derive typed counts from the blind definitions below. Then trace every known source bypass and new/from_dict path, test the proposed event semantics on paper against actual method dispatch, and identify any conversion/inherited method that can escape the kernel or change solver behavior.
joints.where_coordinator_thinks_it_breaks: A direct integer or native-domain operation bypasses declared methods, reverse division is double charged, or exact ring.rem/monic expectations omit a call.

joints.scope: Ordinary fixtures, subgroup/lifts, full S3/S4/Bareiss construction, tracked Gröbner derivations, independent checking, signed columns, planted/random controls and legal wrong-field rank.
joints.attack_plan: Independently derive the small F5/ell7 point relations and row ranks from public definitions; check simultaneous S4 binding and Bareiss divisions, then challenge DAG ideal-inclusion logic and every signed/duplicate target-column case. Verify both S3 and S4 have genuine planted-positive solver controls.
joints.where_coordinator_thinks_it_breaks: A remainder term is falsely treated as an ideal element, a signed point is absent from columns, or a wrong-field matrix is not realizable by the supplied legal certificates.

joints.scope: Seed/count schedule,1600roots,48000primary/48000warmup/24000profile components, mode pairing, timing-mode boundary attribution, load/drift targets and2000paired resamples.
joints.attack_plan: Reconstruct cell/component totals independently and map each primary time to its paired count and separate profile audit. Derive mutually exclusive delta categories from bare tolerances, then challenge missing-size, undefined-bootstrap and sign-unspecified drift cases. Demonstrate why a tiny significant delta can be practical agreement.
joints.where_coordinator_thinks_it_breaks: A profile clock leaks into primary timing, a seeded pair is duplicated/resampled inconsistently, or an incomplete size enters a survivor-only fit.

joints.scope: Full resource stages, unique shared ownership, actual six-process topology, sealed schedules/receipts, calibration stop gate, checkpoints/terminal adapter and independent-review-before-implementation authority.
joints.attack_plan: Trace one full job and a failed-first-calibration campaign, accounting for every process, relation, shared object and receipt. Verify producer/verifier never overlap with four burners, rank costs are owned once, roots are not mislabeled unactivated, and inherited timeout/degree semantics are explicitly amended without goal cancellation.
joints.where_coordinator_thinks_it_breaks: A seventh process or duplicate rank/setup cost appears, a root lacks a final receipt, or a design output hash is mistaken for a completed activation gate.
